quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals to warn other drivers. A straight left arm means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show important rules. This sign tells drivers to keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic when possible.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles, animals, or pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum height allowed for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width allowed for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then left. Slow down to safely follow the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Make space for drivers to safely merge into traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Keep to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Make space for drivers to safely merge into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging ahead. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop. Then go when it is safe.
Pass through the intersection carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop. Then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must stop completely at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to situations ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare to turn or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing down is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are near a school or school crossing. Stay alert and be ready to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns that you will have fewer lanes ahead and must merge left.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. These dangers may include changes in traffic direction, steep hills, or other situations that need your attention.

questions.question: This shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing down means you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn about upcoming hazards or special conditions. Construction areas are marked with orange warning signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn when the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn when the light is red.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right or left when the traffic light is red.

questions.question: What does this pennant-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you to slow down and watch for children near a school.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: When shown on the back of a vehicle, this sign means:

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, and farm equipment display this sign to warn other drivers they will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about a school zone. It may show a school crossing where children or pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: This sign means there is a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: This sign warns that:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and bright jackets. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to what is just ahead. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less for the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less for the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They show upcoming hazards. Speed plaques on these signs show the safe speed to use.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before proceeding.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions coming up. This sign warns drivers about a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions coming up. This sign warns drivers about a curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions coming up. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you there is a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around if you are driving toward this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can only drive straight ahead.
You are approaching a divided highway.
You can turn left or drive straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or drive straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You can turn left or continue straight in a lane controlled by this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn about hazards. Orange signs are used for warnings in construction or maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road goes steeply downhill ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that bicycles may cross here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that pedestrians may cross here. Stop and wait until pedestrians finish crossing.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from top to bottom as red, yellow, and green. Red is always on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangle on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and road maintenance vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending and to prepare for merging traffic.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign where traffic comes from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign. It tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that road work is coming up. Stay alert for traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Only cross when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a side road is coming up ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to road conditions that may not be obvious. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of an upcoming steep hill. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: A red sign means an action is prohibited. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let traffic crossing your path pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic crossing your path pass before you go.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you before proceeding. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this symbol mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: You see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it. What should you do?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at a sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You may turn left only on a green arrow.
You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
You must wait for the solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let others pass. After you yield, you may follow the directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
The road is about to narrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to potential hazards. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet because it becomes slippery.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Turn on your signal and proceed at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for vehicles on the other road to pass. You do not need to stop if no vehicles are coming, but you should slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs show information about services for drivers. They tell you about rest areas, food, hospitals, and other helpful locations.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersects ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve or a narrowing road. You may see these signs on curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign shows a traffic signal picture. It warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Drive carefully and be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is illegal and unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic travels in both directions on this road.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
Do not go until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to other vehicles and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you are near a school. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly. Be prepared to reduce your speed.
